title: Welcome to Abhi’s Space
text: Hello, I’m Abhi! I’m a student, naturalist, wildlife photographer, musician, and an endlessly curious person who loves exploring the world around me. I’m interested in the little details that often go unnoticed, and the surreality of our everyday lives. I enjoy capturing the beauty of nature through my lens and sharing my experiences with others. When I’m not out in the wild, you can find me strumming my guitar or diving into a good book. Welcome to my space, where I share my passions and adventures!

title: A little about me
text:
I’m Abhi, a student, wildlife photographer, naturalist, musician, and a few other things that don’t fit neatly into a single box.
I spend a lot of my time at Farmhill, where I’m learning about the natural world by actually getting out into it. I’m interested in ecology, birds, and the small, often overlooked details of the landscapes around me.
Lately, that’s meant spending time observing wildlife, documenting biodiversity, and exploring ideas around ecological restoration.
Photography is a big part of this. I like being able to spend time with a subject, understand it a little better, and come away with a photograph that tells some part of its story.
I’m particularly drawn to birds and wildlife, although I’m just as likely to photograph an interesting landscape or some tiny detail I happened to notice.
Outside the field, I play guitar and drums, write music, run, trek, and occasionally get carried away with an entirely unrelated interest.
I like learning things, making things, and figuring out how things work. Sometimes that leads somewhere useful. Sometimes it leads to twenty open browser tabs and a new project I probably didn’t need to start.

title: A little about me
text:
Hi, I’m Abhi! I’m a student, naturalist, wildlife photographer, musician, and an endlessly curious person. I love exploring the world, learning how it works, and finding stories in places that people often overlook.
I’m particularly interested in ecology, biodiversity, conservation, and ecological restoration. Much of my time goes into observing wildlife, documenting the natural world, developing field projects, and figuring out how we can better understand and protect the places we live in.

title: A little about me
text:
My world revolves around…

🌿 Ecology and the natural world
Nature is more than a collection of species to identify. I’m fascinated by the relationships between organisms, their habitats, and the processes that shape landscapes. I’m especially interested in biodiversity, field ecology, conservation, and restoration.
I enjoy learning through direct observation and practical work, whether that’s documenting species, exploring a habitat, collecting field data, or experimenting with ways to improve the land around me.


📷 Photography and storytelling
Photography is one of my favourite ways to explore and communicate. I’m drawn to birds, wildlife, landscapes, and small details that are easy to miss when we’re in a hurry.
I want my photographs to do more than look good. I want them to encourage people to pause, notice something new, and perhaps care a little more about the world in front of them.


🎸 Music and creativity
Away from the field, I play guitar and drums, experiment with songwriting, and explore different musical ideas. I love music that tells a story and makes you feel something.
Writing, photography, and music are different ways for me to express ideas that don’t always fit neatly into ordinary conversation.


🏃 The outdoors
Running, trekking, and exploring unfamiliar places give me a different perspective on the world. I enjoy the challenge of going further, learning new skills, and spending time outside without necessarily having a particular destination in mind.


🧠 Everything else
I’m interested in psychology, sociology, science, and the ways people understand and interact with the world. I like connecting ideas across disciplines and asking questions that don’t always have straightforward answers.
I also have a habit of becoming intensely interested in something, researching it far more than necessary, and turning it into a project.

title: A little about me
text:
What I’m working on
I’m always learning and building something. Some of my interests develop into long-term projects; others begin as experiments or questions that I simply can’t leave alone.
At the moment, my interests include:

Documenting the biodiversity of the landscapes around me.
Developing ecological fieldwork and restoration projects.
Improving my wildlife photography and naturalist skills.
Learning to collect, analyse, and interpret ecological data.
Creating stories through writing, photography, and film.

This website will gradually become a record of that process: the discoveries, the experiments, the successes, and the occasional spectacular failure.

title: A little about me
text:
Why this website exists
This website is a place to put some of that work.
You’ll find my photographs, field notes, ecological projects, writing, and other things I feel like sharing. It’s not intended to be a perfectly curated record of everything I’ve done.
I’d rather it grow with me, reflect what I’m learning, and leave room for things I haven’t discovered yet.
Have a look around.
